title: APRS
description: APRS station — map, messenger, beacons over APRS-IS.
summary: An APRS (Automatic Packet Reporting System) station. A live map pinpoints stations and messages received in your filter area, a messenger panel shows text messages addressed to you, a beacon composer crafts position / status / emergency / timed beacons, and settings hold your callsign, position, network and digipeater path. Connects to APRS-IS over a raw TCP socket via the HAL; the passcode is computed so it can transmit.
